title: MagAttract + Metapolyzyme Metagenomic gDNA Extraction from Skin Swabs
author: Natalie Ring
materials: Quantify DNA using Qubit dsDNA HS kit. If DNA concentration is an appropriate concentration for your experiment (for us, this means at least 0.2 ng/µl), continue to clean-up steps. Qubit® dsDNA HS Assay Kit Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #Q32854 1 µL, DNA 199 µL, Qubit dsDNA HS working solution

Quantify DNA using Qubit dsDNA HS kit. If DNA concentration is an appropriate concentration for your experiment (for us, this means at least 0.2 ng/µl), continue to library preparation. Qubit® dsDNA HS Assay Kit Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #Q32854 1 µL, DNA 199 µL, Qubit dsDNA HS working solution

steps.title: Prepare Swab Sample
steps.instruction: Bathe the swab tip in 3 ml PBS in the swab tube for 10 minutes with occasional vortexing. Remove the swab by squeezing the sides.

steps.title: Pellet Cells
steps.instruction: Divide the cell-PBS solution into two 1.5 ml aliquots in 1.5 ml tubes and centrifuge at maximum speed (13,000 RPM / 16,000 x g) for 20 minutes at room temperature. Discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend and Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellets and combine them in 160 µl buffer P1 (50 mM Tris, 10 mM EDTA, pH 8.0).

steps.title: Metapolyzyme Digestion
steps.instruction: Add 20 µl metapolyzyme (3.3 mg/ml, prepared as 5 mg resuspended in 1500 µl PBS) and mix by flicking the tube.

steps.title: Incubate Metapolyzyme
steps.instruction: Incubate on a thermomixer for 60 minutes at 37°C with 900 RPM shaking.

steps.title: Proteinase K Treatment
steps.instruction: Add 20 µl MagAttract proteinase K and mix by flicking the tube.

steps.title: Incubate Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Incubate on a thermomixer for 30 minutes at 56°C with 900 RPM shaking.

steps.title: Add Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 150 µl MagAttract buffer AL and mix by pulse vortexing (10 short <1 second pulses per tube).

steps.title: Bind DNA to Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Add 15 µl MagAttract Suspension G (ensure beads are well mixed/vortexed for 10+ seconds) and 280 µl MagAttract buffer MB. Mix by pulse vortexing.

steps.title: Isolate Beads
steps.instruction: Spin down briefly, pellet beads on a magnet, and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer MW1
steps.instruction: Perform the following wash cycle twice: Add 700 µl MagAttract buffer MW1, incubate on a thermomixer for 1 minute at room temperature with 1,400 RPM shaking, spin down briefly, pellet beads on magnet, and remove supernatant.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer PE
steps.instruction: Perform the following wash cycle twice: Add 700 µl MagAttract buffer PE, incubate on a thermomixer for 1 minute at room temperature with 1,400 RPM shaking, spin down briefly, pellet beads on magnet, and remove supernatant.

steps.title: Rinse with Distilled Water
steps.instruction: Rinse pelleted beads on the magnetic rack with 700 µl distilled water by pipetting down the opposite wall of the tube. Incubate for 1 minute on the magnetic rack, then remove the distilled water.

steps.title: Elute DNA from Beads
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl nuclease-free water off the magnet to resuspend the bead pellet. Incubate on a thermomixer for 3 minutes at room temperature with 1,400 RPM shaking.

steps.title: Collect DNA Supernatant
steps.instruction: Spin down briefly, pellet beads on the magnetic rack, and transfer the supernatant to a low-DNA binding 1.5 mL tube (e.g., Eppendorf or Sarstedt).

steps.title: Bind DNA to ProNex Beads
steps.instruction: Add 150 µl room temperature ProNex beads (vortexed for 10+ seconds) to the DNA (approx 49 µl). Mix well by slowly pipetting up and down 10 times.

steps.title: Incubate ProNex Beads
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes (no shaking).

steps.title: Isolate ProNex Beads
steps.instruction: Spin down briefly, pellet beads on magnet, and remove supernatant.

steps.title: Wash ProNex Beads
steps.instruction: Perform the following wash cycle twice: Rinse pelleted beads on the magnetic rack by pipetting 200 µl ProNex Wash Buffer down the opposite wall of the tube, incubate at room temperature for 60 seconds (no shaking), and remove the Wash Buffer.

steps.title: Dry Beads
steps.instruction: Air-dry the sample on the magnetic rack with the lid open for 5 minutes (up to 60 minutes).

steps.title: Final Elution
steps.instruction: Add 20 µl nuclease-free water off the magnet. Resuspend the pellet by flicking the tube and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes (no shaking).

steps.title: Final DNA Recovery
steps.instruction: Perform the following recovery cycle twice: Spin down briefly, pellet beads on magnet, transfer supernatant to a low DNA-binding tube, and incubate on a thermomixer for 3 minutes at room temperature with 1,400 RPM shaking. Finally, spin down briefly and remove any remaining supernatant.
